text:
Ravi (PM): Hey team — quick review on a few API key UX things before the next sprint: streamline create copy, clarify disable vs revoke, keyboard shortcuts, and empty-state guidance. Figma: https://figma.com/s/keys-ux-clarity
Mira (design): I prototyped a subtle 'safety' affordance: inline action defaults to 'Disable (soft)' and the detailed drawer contains 'Revoke (hard)'. This should reduce accidental permanent revokes.
Abe (eng): Backend distinction confirmed: Disable toggles a flag that blocks new token exchanges; Revoke adds the key to the denylist and invalidates existing tokens. We can implement an undo window for Disable (~2m) easily.
Sasha (a11y): A11y notes: don't rely on color. Add icons and explicit text, and for the undo snackbar ensure role="status" and focusable undo link. Announce actions via aria-live: "Key X disabled" / "Key X revoked".
Mira (design): Create modal copy proposal: header "Create API key" body: "You will see the secret only once. Download it or save to your vault." Primary CTA: "Download secret" secondary: "Copy & close". Default scope = "Read-only" and a small hint: "Change to higher scopes if needed." 
Ravi (PM): We also want a shorter inline hint on the list row: "Last used: 3h ago" and a masked IP hint like "IP: 203.*.*.45" to help owners decide to revoke.
Abe (eng): Telemetry note: we'll only surface last 5 masked IPs and the last-used timestamp. Also add a tiny sparkline for token usage in the last 24h.
Mira (design): Empty state copy different tone: "No keys yet — create one to get started. Tip: create a dev key (read-only) for testing, then rotate before production." Provide a one-line quickstart snippet and default focus on Create.
Sasha (a11y): Empty state must move keyboard focus to the primary CTA on load and include aria-describedby linking to security guidance: "Start with read-only keys for testing." The quickstart code block should be role="region" and tabbable.
Ravi (PM): Shortcut ideas: 'c' to open create, 'r' to rotate when a row is focused, 'd' to disable. We need a discoverable cheat-sheet (press '?') that is keyboard-accessible.
Abe (eng): We'll implement shortcuts with a focus-aware handler so they act on the focused row. Also an opt-out setting in user prefs for shortcut keys.
Mira (design): For rotate UX: inline rotate produces a new secret in an ephemeral panel (single-show). Show a countdown during the 30-min overlap window with a clear 'Undo rotate' CTA while overlap active.
Sasha (a11y): When the new secret appears, move focus to it and set role="region" aria-label="new secret". After close or timeout remove it from DOM so screen readers don't retain it. Toasts on copy should use role="status".
Ravi (PM): Confirm wording for warn dialogs: current draft: "This will immediately stop any clients using this key. Consider rotating instead to avoid downtime." Suggestions for brevity? 
Mira (design): Shorter alt: "This will stop clients using this key immediately. Revoke anyway?" Keep confirm CTA "Revoke permanently".
Abe (eng): Edge-case: if user tries to revoke a key that's used by active infra, surface a small checklist in the dialog: last used, top IPs, and an option to create a replacement key before proceeding.
Sasha (a11y): Dialog must trap focus, provide an accessible summary of potential impact, and support type-to-confirm if requested by security policy. Also ensure aria-describedby contains the checklist.
tooling-bot: preview build deployed -> https://preview.redwood.ai/keys-clarity (preview)
Ravi (PM): Thanks — I'll update the mocks with these copy and a11y tweaks. If no objections I'll flag eng to start a small prototype and schedule a keyboard/a11y pass next week. :thumbsup:
Mira (design): :+1:
Abe (eng): Good to go on our side.
Sasha (a11y): I'll run the SR walkthrough once preview is up.
